name: market and gateway subdomain scheme web to union
asks: market.561.group is supposed to be not specialized to any one chain: it's supposed to be the Web<->Union market, letting folk pay with whatever we accept (which should include, someday, Stripe). Specialized markets like base.market.561.group, hive.market.561.group, are great. [...] my current rpeference is market.561.group, gateway.561.group, hive.market.561group, hive.gateway.561.group, with "gateway" being not the Web<->UnionMarket, but the Web<->UnionWorld, like... which is the market but is also more? Hard to explain.
